description.narrative: The objective of the Conditional Credit Line for Investment Projects (CCLIP) is to help improve access to and the quality of secondary education. The objective of the first individual operation under the CCLIP is to improve access to and the quality of secondary education in Uruguay with the aim of achieving seamless and complete learning pathways.

el objetivo de la Lnea de Crdito Condicional para Proyectos de Inversin (CCLIP) es contribuir a mejorar el acceso y la calidad de la educacin media.
